title: Extract a catering invoice with line items
levels: Every field matches the source and the schema exactly
At least one field is missing, extra, of the wrong type or different from the source

cases.rationale: Every field and all three line items match the invoice, and due_date is null because the invoice states no due date.
due_date is "2026-11-11", a date the invoice never states, where the schema requires null when no due date is given.
total_minor is the string "45000" where the schema requires an integer, 45000.
The values, types and line item order all match the invoice; the keys are only arranged differently.
